title: At the Restaurant
description: Four short recordings about eating out: booking a table, ordering, a special offer and paying the bill.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Booking a table
parts.intro: You will hear a man, Nam, phoning a restaurant to book a table.

script.speaker: Waitress
script.text: Hello, Blue Garden Restaurant. How can I help you?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Hello. I'd like to book a table for Saturday evening, please.

script.speaker: Waitress
script.text: Certainly. How many people?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Five people, no, sorry, six. My brother is coming too.

script.speaker: Waitress
script.text: And what time would you like?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: At seven o'clock, please.

script.speaker: Waitress
script.text: I'm sorry, we are full at seven. We have a table at half past seven.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: That's fine. Half past seven is OK.

script.speaker: Waitress
script.text: Could I have your name, please?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: It's Nam Tran. Thank you very much.

parts.title: Part 2 · Ordering food
parts.intro: You will hear a waiter and a girl, Lily, ordering lunch.

script.speaker: Waiter
script.text: Good afternoon. Are you ready to order?

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: Yes, please. I'd like the chicken soup to start.

script.speaker: Waiter
script.text: And for the main course?

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: Hmm. Is the fish good today?

script.speaker: Waiter
script.text: Yes, it's very fresh. It comes with potatoes and green beans.

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: I don't like beans. Can I have salad instead?

script.speaker: Waiter
script.text: Of course. And to drink?

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: A glass of water, please. No juice for me.

script.speaker: Waiter
script.text: Would you like a dessert?

script.speaker: Lily
script.text: Yes! One ice cream, please. I love chocolate ice cream.

parts.title: Part 3 · A special offer
parts.intro: You will hear a radio advertisement for a restaurant.

script.speaker: Presenter
script.text: Are you hungry? Come to Mama Rosa's Kitchen! We are in the town centre, next to the post office.

script.speaker: Presenter
script.text: We are open every day from eleven o'clock in the morning until ten o'clock at night.

script.speaker: Presenter
script.text: This week, we have a special family menu. Two adults and two children eat for only thirty pounds.

script.speaker: Presenter
script.text: Our pizza is famous. Children can make their own pizza on Sunday afternoons. It's great fun!

script.speaker: Presenter
script.text: And on Monday, we are closed in the morning, because we clean the kitchen. Come and see us soon!

parts.title: Part 4 · Paying the bill
parts.intro: You will hear Mr Park and a waitress at the end of a meal.

script.speaker: Mr Park
script.text: Excuse me. Can we have the bill, please?

script.speaker: Waitress
script.text: Certainly, sir. Did you enjoy your meal?

script.speaker: Mr Park
script.text: Yes, thank you. The soup was delicious. But my daughter says the pasta was too salty.

script.speaker: Waitress
script.text: Oh, I'm sorry about that. I'll tell the cook.

script.speaker: Mr Park
script.text: That's OK. How much is it?

script.speaker: Waitress
script.text: Two soups, one pasta and two drinks. It's twenty-eight pounds.

script.speaker: Mr Park
script.text: Can I pay by card?

script.speaker: Waitress
script.text: I'm sorry, the card machine is broken today. Only cash, please.

script.speaker: Mr Park
script.text: Oh dear. I have thirty pounds. Here you are. Keep the change.

script.speaker: Waitress
script.text: Thank you very much, sir. Have a nice evening!
